name: BotSieve – Bot & Fake Traffic Detector
author: custonis

sections.description:
BotSieve helps website owners understand who is actually visiting their website.

Traditional analytics tools count nearly all requests equally, including bots, crawlers, scanners and suspicious traffic. BotSieve focuses on traffic quality and behavioral analysis instead of raw traffic numbers.

The plugin analyzes incoming requests locally on your WordPress installation and classifies traffic into categories such as:

  • Real visitors
  • AI crawlers
  • SEO crawlers
  • Known bots
  • Suspicious requests

BotSieve provides a modern dashboard with real-time traffic insights and crawler intelligence.

Features

  • Traffic Quality Overview (last 24 hours)
  • Real visitor vs crawler detection
  • AI crawler detection
  • Suspicious traffic detection
  • Top detected bots overview
  • Average trust score
  • Request activity timeline
  • Behavioral crawler insights
  • Rapid crawl detection
  • URL exploration detection
  • Lightweight modern dashboard UI
  • No external API calls
  • No third-party tracking
  • Local-only data storage

Dashboard Overview

BotSieve includes:

  • Traffic Quality cards
  • Real vs crawler traffic distribution
  • Top Bots monitoring
  • Traffic activity timeline
  • Behavioral insights
  • Aggressive crawler detection
  • Trust scoring system
  • Live monitoring interface

Use Cases

BotSieve is useful for:

  • Website owners
  • SEO professionals
  • Publishers and bloggers
  • Lead generation websites
  • Security-conscious site operators
  • AI crawler monitoring
  • WordPress administrators
  • Anyone interested in cleaner traffic analytics

Privacy

BotSieve does not send collected traffic data to external servers.

All request analysis happens locally inside your WordPress installation.

The plugin stores request-related metadata such as:

  • URLs
  • Request timestamps
  • User agents
  • Request behavior patterns
  • Hashed IP information

No personal visitor profiles are created.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin
  3. Open “BotSieve” in the WordPress dashboard
sections.faq:
Does BotSieve block bots?

No. BotSieve focuses on traffic analysis, classification and monitoring.

Does BotSieve work with caching plugins?

Yes. BotSieve is designed to work alongside common WordPress caching setups.

Does the plugin affect performance?

BotSieve is lightweight and optimized for minimal performance impact.

Does BotSieve use external APIs?

No. The plugin works fully locally without external API calls.

Is visitor data sent to third parties?

No. All collected data remains on your own WordPress installation.

What types of bots can BotSieve detect?

BotSieve can detect:

  • AI crawlers
  • SEO crawlers
  • Known bots
  • Suspicious scanners
  • Behavioral crawlers
  • Exploratory requests
